اعتبرتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَبَرْتُنَّ (iʕtabartunna) /iʕ.ta.bar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اُعْتُبِرْتُنَّ (uʕtubirtunna) /uʕ.tu.bir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
